fiesta.title: Fiesta Gastro Cafe
fiesta.summary: Trilingual (RO/EN/RU) cafe website with an admin panel for staff to manage content.
description: Fiesta Gastro Cafe needed a website that works for its guests in three languages and that its own staff can run without a developer. I built a complete platform in Romanian, English, and Russian, where visitors browse the full menu, discover the cafe, and see events and charity initiatives.
Everything is managed from a custom admin panel: menu items, translations, images, pages, and contact details. Staff update content in minutes, and changes appear on the site immediately.

Under the hood, a Django REST API serves content to a React 19 + TypeScript frontend styled with Tailwind. Data lives in PostgreSQL, media in Cloudflare R2, and the whole project is containerized with Docker and deployed on Render with a custom domain managed through Cloudflare.
fiesta.role: Solo full-stack developer. Responsible for architecture, backend API, frontend, deployment, and domain setup.

vm-ai.title: VM.AI
vm-ai.summary: A seven-stage machine learning pipeline built for Moldova's national AI olympiad.
description: VM.AI is a seven-stage machine learning pipeline built for ONIA 2026, Moldova's national AI olympiad. Each stage takes the output of the previous one, from raw data to a scored result.
I built the stage runner and the data handling, and packaged the pipeline so it can be run and reproduced outside the competition.
